params.O: min(1, log2(1 + n) / log2(33)); n = independent outlet groups (one per owner group, else per domain)
params.C: min(1, (k − 1) / 4); k = distinct outlet countries (unknown counts 0)
params.R: 0 for one country or unknown; 0.5 for 2+ countries in one region (or the EU / euro area, or a named region without a country); 0.75 for 2 regions; 1 for 3+ regions or global
params.K: highest category weight of the story (0 without a category); a major world event (D-19) counts as weight event_weight
params.M: kind weight of the strongest linked official release, else 0
params.P: min(1, (h − 1) / 11); h = distinct UTC hours, within 48 h of first seen, in which a new outlet group appeared
params.T: 0.5 ^ (age_h / 24); age_h = hours from first seen to computed_at
